crossPollination: Semantic failure-domain review showed that a finite byte throat does not guarantee a finite parser failure domain. That same resource-skepticism was applied to diagnostic projection, exposing snapshot custody's escape-before-collapse allocation. The shared semantic-text-safety law kept both repairs from rewriting exact evidence. Regnet-style self-review then caught the accessibility fixture asking for explicit non-color state that the Warm Wall did not yet state, so the source specimen—not the assertion—was repaired.
